title: NantexzStudios Build
description: This modpack includes all the mods we use for building. It’s designed to enhance creativity and make the building process easier and more enjoyable.
body:
🎨 NantexzStudios Building Pack

Welcome to the official NantexzStudios Building Pack, a carefully curated modpack designed to elevate your building experience in Minecraft!

This pack includes all the essential mods we use in our creative projects — whether you're constructing detailed cities, immersive landscapes, or complex architectural builds, this setup provides the perfect tools to help you bring your ideas to life. From decorative blocks and intuitive tools to performance-enhancing tweaks, every mod is selected to support smooth, imaginative, and collaborative building.

🔧 Features:

A wide selection of building-focused mods

Tools to make planning and designing easier

Performance optimizations for large creative worlds

Compatible with both singleplayer and multiplayer

Ideal for creative mode builders, mapmakers, and studios

💬 Need help or want to share your creations?
Join our official Discord community, where you can:

Ask questions and get support

Share screenshots of your builds

Suggest mods or improvements

Collaborate with other builders from the Nantexz community

👉 Join us here:[Discord](https://discord.gg/dHQvatpFca)

Let your creativity run wild — and happy building from all of us at NantexzStudios!
